create_random_sampler: create a RandomSampler instance with num samples, pos_fraction, and add_gt_as_proposals options
random_choice_select: use random_choice to randomly select num elements from a Tensor or list gallery
sample_positive_bbox: call _sample_pos to randomly sample positive bounding box indices from an assign result
sample_negative_bbox: call _sample_neg to randomly sample negative bounding box indices from an assign result
review_random_sampler_class: review the RandomSampler class and its random sampling methods for bounding box assignment
